thread:
Priya K: Morning — handing off oncall to @Sam T for the day. Quick summary below, please ping me if anything odd.

Priya K: What changed:
- Deployed runtime v3.2.1 canary last night (partial traffic).
- Small DB migration bumped connection pool; migration completed but we saw some transient 5xx on /embeddings during the window.
- Cache node that flapped last week is stable after config tweak (Luis).

Alex B: FYI — full rollout scheduled today at 13:30 UTC (canary -> 25% -> 100%). Watchlist: embeddings latency & 5xx rate, and the new migration's connection saturations.

Luis M: Last night the S3 auth errors that hit cache priming were traced to token refresh skew. Fixed and requeued jobs; background backfill running (~6h ETA). Expect slightly higher cold-starts for embedding requests until warm.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: service=runtime, commit=abc1234, namespace=prod.
```
kubectl -n prod rollout status deploy/runtime
# watch pods with label app=runtime
```

Sam T: I'm on from ~09:00-17:00 PT. I'll keep the 5xx alert pager enabled. If we see >0.5% 5xx on /embeddings for 5m, I'll pause rollout and roll back.

Priya K: Action items for Sam:
1) Add temporary alert: embeddings 5xx threshold -> 0.5% (5m).
2) If 5xx spike, run rollback: `./scripts/rollback runtime abc1234` and notify infra + eng-sre.
3) Keep an eye on DB connection pool metrics (pg_connections / pool_size).

Sam T: Got it. I added the alert and annotated the canary run in the rollout doc. I'll also reduce canary weight if cold-starts stay high. :thumbsup:

Maria P: Security note — dependency scan flagged a low-severity issue in `json-utils` used by the telemetry agent. Not blocking the rollout but opening a dependency PR; tagging eng-oncall for visibility.

Luis M: If you see cache warmup errors, run: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-cache-backups/current /tmp/cache-backup --recursive` and then restart cache pods one-by-one.

Sam T: Will do. I'll post an update after the 13:30 UTC step and if I hit any manual rollbacks.

Priya K: Thanks — handing off now. Leaving the postmortem notes link in the thread if anything escalates: https://redwood/internal/handovers/1776123456 :wave:

Sam T: Thanks Priya. I'll close the thread when the rollout completes.

deploy-bot: rollout update: runtime canary -> 25% succeeded (13:45 UTC). No elevated 5xx in the first 15m.

Sam T: Noted — continuing to watch.
